relations: SELECT n.nspname AS schema_name,c.relname,c.relkind,c.relpersistence,c.relrowsecurity,c.relforcerowsecurity,c.reloptions,pg_get_userbyid(c.relowner) AS owner,c.relacl::text AS acl FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname IN ('gradebook','student_portal','student_photos','system_health') AND c.relkind IN ('r','p','v','m','S','f') ORDER BY n.nspname,c.relname;
columns: SELECT n.nspname AS schema_name,c.relname,a.attname,a.attnum,format_type(a.atttypid,a.atttypmod) AS data_type,a.attnotnull,a.attidentity,a.attgenerated,pg_get_expr(d.adbin,d.adrelid) AS default_expression,cn.nspname AS collation_schema,co.collname AS collation_name,a.attacl::text AS acl FROM pg_attribute a JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid=a.attrelid JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace LEFT JOIN pg_attrdef d ON d.adrelid=c.oid AND d.adnum=a.attnum LEFT JOIN pg_collation co ON co.oid=a.attcollation LEFT JOIN pg_namespace cn ON cn.oid=co.collnamespace WHERE n.nspname IN ('gradebook','student_portal','student_photos','system_health') AND c.relkind IN ('r','p','v','m','f') AND a.attnum>0 AND NOT a.attisdropped ORDER BY n.nspname,c.relname,a.attnum;
constraints: SELECT n.nspname AS schema_name,c.relname,con.conname,con.contype,con.convalidated,con.condeferrable,con.condeferred,pg_get_constraintdef(con.oid,true) AS definition FROM pg_constraint con JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid=con.conrelid JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname IN ('gradebook','student_portal','student_photos','system_health') ORDER BY n.nspname,c.relname,con.conname;
indexes: SELECT n.nspname AS schema_name,c.relname AS table_name,i.relname AS index_name,pg_get_indexdef(i.oid) AS definition,x.indisvalid,x.indisready,x.indisunique,x.indisprimary,EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pg_constraint con WHERE con.conindid=i.oid AND con.conrelid=c.oid AND con.contype IN ('p','u','x')) AS constraint_owned FROM pg_index x JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid=x.indrelid JOIN pg_class i ON i.oid=x.indexrelid JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname IN ('gradebook','student_portal','student_photos','system_health') ORDER BY n.nspname,c.relname,i.relname;
sequences: SELECT n.nspname AS schema_name,c.relname,format_type(s.seqtypid,NULL) AS data_type,s.seqstart::text AS seqstart,s.seqincrement::text AS seqincrement,s.seqmax::text AS seqmax,s.seqmin::text AS seqmin,s.seqcache::text AS seqcache,s.seqcycle,tn.nspname AS owned_schema,t.relname AS owned_table,a.attname AS owned_column,dep.deptype FROM pg_sequence s JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid=s.seqrelid JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace LEFT JOIN pg_depend dep ON dep.classid='pg_class'::regclass AND dep.objid=c.oid AND dep.refclassid='pg_class'::regclass AND dep.deptype IN ('a','i') LEFT JOIN pg_class t ON t.oid=dep.refobjid LEFT JOIN pg_namespace tn ON tn.oid=t.relnamespace LEFT JOIN pg_attribute a ON a.attrelid=t.oid AND a.attnum=dep.refobjsubid WHERE n.nspname IN ('gradebook','student_portal','student_photos','system_health') ORDER BY n.nspname,c.relname;
policies: SELECT n.nspname AS schema_name,c.relname,p.polname,p.polpermissive,p.polcmd,ARRAY(SELECT CASE WHEN r=0 THEN 'PUBLIC' ELSE pg_get_userbyid(r) END FROM unnest(p.polroles) r ORDER BY r) AS roles,pg_get_expr(p.polqual,p.polrelid) AS using_expression,pg_get_expr(p.polwithcheck,p.polrelid) AS check_expression FROM pg_policy p JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid=p.polrelid JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname IN ('gradebook','student_portal','student_photos','system_health') ORDER BY n.nspname,c.relname,p.polname;
triggers: SELECT n.nspname AS schema_name,c.relname,t.tgname,t.tgenabled,t.tgdeferrable,t.tginitdeferred,pg_get_triggerdef(t.oid,true) AS definition,pn.nspname AS function_schema,p.proname AS function_name FROM pg_trigger t JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid=t.tgrelid JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace JOIN pg_proc p ON p.oid=t.tgfoid JOIN pg_namespace pn ON pn.oid=p.pronamespace WHERE n.nspname IN ('gradebook','student_portal','student_photos','system_health') AND NOT t.tgisinternal ORDER BY n.nspname,c.relname,t.tgname;
views: SELECT n.nspname AS schema_name,c.relname,pg_get_viewdef(c.oid,true) AS definition,c.reloptions FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname IN ('gradebook','student_portal','student_photos','system_health') AND c.relkind IN ('v','m') ORDER BY n.nspname,c.relname;
types: SELECT n.nspname AS schema_name,t.typname,t.typtype,t.typcategory,format_type(t.typbasetype,t.typtypmod) AS base_type,t.typnotnull,t.typdefault,ARRAY(SELECT e.enumlabel FROM pg_enum e WHERE e.enumtypid=t.oid ORDER BY e.enumsortorder) AS enum_labels FROM pg_type t JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=t.typnamespace WHERE n.nspname IN ('gradebook','student_portal','student_photos','system_health') AND t.typtype IN ('d','e') ORDER BY n.nspname,t.typname;
default_acls: SELECT pg_get_userbyid(d.defaclrole) AS owner,n.nspname AS schema_name,d.defaclobjtype,d.defaclacl::text AS acl FROM pg_default_acl d LEFT JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=d.defaclnamespace WHERE n.nspname IN ('gradebook','student_portal','student_photos','system_health') OR d.defaclnamespace=0 ORDER BY owner,schema_name,defaclobjtype;
function_hashes: SELECT n.nspname AS schema_name,p.proname,pg_get_function_identity_arguments(p.oid) AS identity_arguments,encode(sha256(convert_to(p.prosrc,'UTF8')),'hex') AS body_sha256 FROM pg_proc p JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=p.pronamespace WHERE n.nspname IN ('gradebook','student_portal','student_photos','system_health') ORDER BY n.nspname,p.proname,identity_arguments;
acls:
WITH objects AS (
SELECT 'schema'::text AS kind,n.nspname AS schema_name,n.nspname AS object_name,NULL::text AS identity_arguments,n.nspowner AS owner,n.nspacl AS acl,'n'::"char" AS acl_kind FROM pg_namespace n WHERE n.nspname IN ('gradebook','student_portal','student_photos','system_health')
UNION ALL SELECT CASE WHEN c.relkind='S' THEN 'sequence' ELSE 'relation' END,n.nspname,c.relname,NULL,c.relowner,c.relacl,CASE WHEN c.relkind='S' THEN 'S' ELSE 'r' END::"char" FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname IN ('gradebook','student_portal','student_photos','system_health') AND c.relkind IN ('r','p','v','m','S')
UNION ALL SELECT 'function',n.nspname,p.proname,pg_get_function_identity_arguments(p.oid),p.proowner,p.proacl,'f'::"char" FROM pg_proc p JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=p.pronamespace WHERE n.nspname IN ('gradebook','student_portal','student_photos','system_health'))
SELECT o.kind,o.schema_name,o.object_name,o.identity_arguments,CASE WHEN a.grantee=0 THEN 'PUBLIC' ELSE pg_get_userbyid(a.grantee) END AS grantee,pg_get_userbyid(a.grantor) AS grantor,a.privilege_type,a.is_grantable FROM objects o CROSS JOIN LATERAL aclexplode(coalesce(o.acl,acldefault(o.acl_kind,o.owner))) a ORDER BY o.kind,o.schema_name,o.object_name,o.identity_arguments,grantee,a.privilege_type;
column_acls: SELECT n.nspname AS schema_name,c.relname AS object_name,a.attname AS column_name,CASE WHEN x.grantee=0 THEN 'PUBLIC' ELSE pg_get_userbyid(x.grantee) END AS grantee,pg_get_userbyid(x.grantor) AS grantor,x.privilege_type,x.is_grantable FROM pg_attribute a JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid=a.attrelid JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace CROSS JOIN LATERAL aclexplode(a.attacl) x WHERE n.nspname IN ('gradebook','student_portal','student_photos','system_health') AND a.attnum>0 AND NOT a.attisdropped ORDER BY schema_name,object_name,column_name,grantee,privilege_type;
functions: SELECT n.nspname,p.proname,pg_get_function_identity_arguments(p.oid) AS identity_arguments,pg_get_function_result(p.oid) AS result,l.lanname,p.prokind,p.prosecdef,p.proleakproof,p.provolatile,p.proparallel,p.proconfig,pg_get_userbyid(p.proowner) AS owner,p.proacl::text AS acl FROM pg_proc p JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=p.pronamespace JOIN pg_language l ON l.oid=p.prolang WHERE n.nspname IN ('gradebook','student_portal','student_photos','system_health') ORDER BY n.nspname,p.proname,identity_arguments;
function_extra: SELECT n.nspname AS schema_name,p.proname,pg_get_function_identity_arguments(p.oid) AS identity_arguments,pg_get_function_arguments(p.oid) AS full_arguments,p.proisstrict,p.procost,p.prorows FROM pg_proc p JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=p.pronamespace WHERE n.nspname IN ('gradebook','student_portal','student_photos','system_health') ORDER BY n.nspname,p.proname,identity_arguments;
